Papyra.//AllowInsecureCookies: Send the session cookie over plain HTTP. Off by default: a Secure cookie is one the browser only returns over a connection it trusts, and a bare IP over http is not one, so signing in appears to work and every refresh signs you out. Turn on ONLY when the transport is already private (a WireGuard/Tailscale tunnel, a host-only network). Anything reachable from an untrusted network needs TLS instead.

Oidc.//: Set Authority + ClientId (+ ClientSecret for confidential clients) to enable OIDC SSO login. Empty = SSO disabled.

Whisper.//: Absolute path to a local Whisper ggml .bin model (e.g. ggml-base.bin). Empty = audio transcription disabled. Only WAV is decoded in-process.

Ocr.//: Absolute path to a Tesseract tessdata dir containing eng.traineddata. Empty = OCR disabled.

Ollama.//: Local Ollama for embeddings + chat. Unreachable = semantic features degrade to keyword search.

WebAuthn.//: Relying-party identity for biometric unlock. ServerDomain is the bare host (no scheme/port); Origins must list every origin the SPA is served from.
